checkout_cart_cart_merge_preference.summary: How a guest cart merges with the saved cart at login.

checkout_cart_configurable_product_image.summary: Which image represents a configurable product in the cart.

checkout_cart_crosssell_enabled.summary: Show cross-sell products on the cart page.

checkout_cart_delete_quote_after.summary: How long an abandoned cart (quote) is kept (days).

checkout_cart_grouped_product_image.summary: Which image represents a grouped product in the cart.

checkout_cart_number_items_to_display_pa.summary: Cart items shown before pagination kicks in.

checkout_cart_redirect_to_cart.summary: Send shoppers to the cart after adding a product.

checkout_cart_link_use_qty.summary: What the header cart link counts.

checkout_options_display_billing_address.summary: Where the billing address is collected during checkout.

checkout_options_enable_agreements.summary: Require shoppers to accept terms and conditions.
checkout_options_enable_agreements.usage: When Yes, the configured checkout agreements (terms & conditions) must be accepted before an order can be placed.

checkout_options_enable_guest_checkout_l.summary: Let guests check whether an email already has an account.
checkout_options_enable_guest_checkout_l.usage: When Yes, unauthenticated shoppers can query whether an email is already registered. Turning it off helps prevent account enumeration.

checkout_options_guest_checkout.summary: Allow ordering without creating an account.

checkout_options_max_items_display_count.summary: Maximum order items shown on the checkout review.

checkout_options_onepage_checkout_enable.usage: When Yes, the built-in one-page checkout is available. Turning it off is usually done only when a custom checkout replaces it.

checkout_payment_failed_copy_method.summary: How copies of payment-failed emails are sent.

checkout_payment_failed_identity.summary: The store identity payment-failed emails are sent from.

checkout_payment_failed_receiver.summary: The store contact that receives payment-failed emails.

checkout_payment_failed_template.summary: The email template for payment-failed notifications.

checkout_sidebar_count.summary: How many items the mini-cart lists.

checkout_sidebar_display.summary: Show the mini-cart in the header.

checkout_sidebar_max_items_display_count.summary: Maximum items shown in the mini-cart before scrolling.
